description.en: The ID of the agent to delete. This parameter cannot be set to `main`.

description.zh: 是否删除工作目录和会话文件，默认true
description.en: Specifies whether to delete the working directory and session files. Default value: `true`.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 该API执行后将返回被成功移除的Agent ID及解除的绑定数量。
- 确保在调用前已知目标`AgentId`，否则操作可能失败或影响非预期的Agent。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

- A successful operation returns the ID of the deleted agent and the number of removed bindings.

- Ensure you provide the correct target `AgentId`. An incorrect ID can cause the operation to fail or affect an unintended agent.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-polar-claw-agent --application-id pa-00000000000000 --agent-id work --delete-files true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DeletePolarClawAgent --region cn-hangzhou --DeleteFiles true --AgentId work --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000'
